about_the_game:
Zeppelin Rush is a reverse tower defense game where you lead a crew of furious goblins in an explosive assault aerial assault against a heavily fortified dwarf stronghold. The dwarves stole your gold, now it’s payback time.

Build and pilot a fleet of goblin-engineered war zeppelins, smashing through enemy towers while collecting loot to upgrade your fleet and multiply your forces. Choose your path across lanes of combat, with varying tower layouts and rewards. Adapt your strategy mid-flight by upgrading engines, armor, and weapons as you make your way further into enemy territory!

Each run is a fast-paced mix of strategy, destruction, and resource management, challenging you to balance risk and reward on the fly. With chaotic goblin tech, real-time destruction, explosive visuals, and strategic lane selection, Zeppelin Rush delivers an action-packed twist on the tower defense formula from the sky, with vengeance.

Take flight. Break towers. Reclaim your gold. The goblins are coming - and nothing is safe...



  • Fast paced gameplay requiring rapid decision making
  • Intense layout of enemy towers that foster intense combat
  • Economy based deployment and upgrade system
